o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *ay- (“to revolve, rotate, go round; to tarry; to lead, lead round; to speed up to drive”). Cognate with Kazakh айналу (aynaluw).
Calque of Russian выступа́ть (vystupátʹ). The sense to 'assume' is a calque of Russian исходи́ть (isxodítʹ).
From the plural of Arabic مَوْهُوم (mawhūm). By surface analysis, mövhum + -at.
